stage_meaning.10: dedicated audit and acceptance scope exist
stage_meaning.25: architecture or delivery contract is accepted
stage_meaning.40: core implementation exists with focused automated evidence
stage_meaning.55: the gate's canonical internal path is integrated end-to-end
stage_meaning.70: the gate's real user-facing or operational path is wired
stage_meaning.85: regression/E2E, exact-head CI, APK/device evidence applicable to the gate are complete
stage_meaning.100: the gate Definition of Done is complete, status/handoff is current, and no gate acceptance gap remains

gates.name: Unified Item + adapter/migration + regression
gates.note: Canonical Task remains the source of truth; Projects assignment and current-main Home editor context are merged without introducing a second Task payload. Strict 85/100 still requires gate-level final E2E/device closure.

gates.name: Notebook UI + persistence
gates.note: Notebook editor/read-only/edit/autosave/checklist flow remains user-facing and persists through canonical TaskStore only. Final physical-device/E2E and handoff closure remain.

gates.name: Home + Search on canonical Item path
gates.note: Home/Search/Today remain wired to canonical Task; current-main Project/category editor context is also merged. Due-date and remaining final Home acceptance lanes are still not fully closed under the strict gate definition.

gates.name: Calendar + Prayer Times + Iranian Holidays
gates.note: Official calendar, Iranian holidays and calculated prayer times are merged. Daily Content and external sync remain non-blocking extensions; strict physical-device/E2E closure is still outstanding.

gates.name: Widget + Lock Screen validation
gates.note: Canonical Android home/keyguard widget and Task-id bridge are wired. Final launcher/keyguard/resize/row-tap physical acceptance remains before 85/100.

gates.name: PDF + Print + report outputs
gates.note: Canonical RTL PDF/Print, grouped Jalali day/range Work Agenda, plain-text rendering and Copy Text are merged on current main. Native text share and canonical typography regression are active lanes; strict device/share acceptance remains.

gates.name: Reminder/Calendar + Backup/Portability/Projects
gates.note: Portable backup/restore, Project persistence/assignment and the current-main Project backup bridge are merged. Independent FollowUp reminder delivery convergence and final physical-device integration remain open under the strict gate definition.

gates.name: E2E + device release + APK evidence
gates.note: Exact-head Fast/Build/Device foundations and the guarded 8-minute Production Orchestrator with automatic Heavy dispatch are merged and actively advancing current-main work. Strict 85/100 still requires final release-wide physical-device E2E closure.

reported_metrics.production_local_apk_readiness_kind: engineering estimate from current GitHub reality and master operating contract; not a replacement for strict gate DoD
